# zsign signing core

Source: https://github.com/zhlynn/zsign

Revision: `614caa8d1ca949e260e5746144aa52d27a4b08d6` (MIT). Only the signing core is embedded.

Regram changes: OpenSSL 1.1 compatibility and private RGUpdateSSL_ symbols/headers, disable desktop subprocess diagnostics, release signing keys on destruction, rename C++ digest helpers to avoid OpenSSL prefix macro collisions, suppress OpenSSL diagnostic output, normalize source whitespace. Archive extraction and installation belong to Regram.
